newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chairman sells 20 mln Anex Int'l shares.
newsitem.headline: Chairman sells 20 mln Anex Int'l shares.

text.p: Anex International Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday its chairman and chief executive Kwok Hon Ching had sold 20 million company shares at HK$1.50 per share on Tuesday.
Kwok's stake in the company has been reduced to 15.37 percent from 20.96 percent, the company said in a statement issued through the stock exchange.

Shares of the consumer electrical products maker ended HK$0.13 or 8.28 percent up at HK$1.70 on Wednesday after they hit a year high of HK$1.71. Volume was 43.05 million shares worth HK$70.07 million.
